professor.name: Ms. Brown
professor.text: Today we talk about free time. Do you like to stay at home or go out on weekends? Why?

students.name: Tom
students.text: I like to stay at home. I watch films and I relax.

students.name: Sara
students.text: I like to go out. I meet my friends in the park.

professor.name: Mr. Lee
professor.text: Some people like summer and some people like winter. Which season do you like? Why?

students.name: Ben
students.text: I like summer. It is hot and I can swim.

students.name: Anna
students.text: I like winter. I love snow and hot chocolate.

professor.name: Dr. Gray
professor.text: Is it better to have a cat or a dog? Why?

students.name: Leo
students.text: A dog is better. Dogs play with you and go for walks.

students.name: Mia
students.text: A cat is better. Cats are quiet and clean.

professor.name: Ms. Clark
professor.text: Do you like to cook at home or eat in restaurants? Why?

students.name: Omar
students.text: I like to cook at home. It is cheap and healthy.

students.name: Lucy
students.text: I like restaurants. I don't need to wash the dishes!

professor.name: Mr. Hill
professor.text: Do you prefer to read books or watch TV? Why?

students.name: Kate
students.text: I prefer books. I can use my imagination.

students.name: Jack
students.text: I prefer TV. It is easy and fun after a long day.

professor.name: Ms. White
professor.text: Is it better to live in a city or in the countryside? Why?

students.name: Paul
students.text: The city is better. There are many shops and buses.

students.name: Emma
students.text: The countryside is better. It is quiet and green.

professor.name: Dr. King
professor.text: Do you like to study in the morning or in the evening? Why?

students.name: Nina
students.text: I study in the morning. My head is fresh.

students.name: Dan
students.text: I study in the evening. The house is quiet then.

professor.name: Mr. Fox
professor.text: Do you like to travel by car or by train? Why?

students.name: Amy
students.text: I like the train. I can read and look out of the window.

students.name: Chris
students.text: I like the car. I can stop when I want.

professor.name: Ms. Hall
professor.text: What is your favorite day of the week? Why?

students.name: Yuki
students.text: My favorite day is Saturday. I don't go to school.

students.name: Mark
students.text: My favorite day is Friday. The weekend starts!

professor.name: Mrs. Green
professor.text: Do you like to play sports or watch sports? Why?

students.name: Ali
students.text: I like to play sports. I love football.

students.name: Jenny
students.text: I like to watch sports on TV with my family.

professor.name: Mr. Davis
professor.text: Is it good for children to have a phone? Why or why not?

students.name: Rosa
students.text: Yes. Children can call their parents.

students.name: Sam
students.text: No. Children play games on the phone too much.

professor.name: Ms. Ford
professor.text: Do you prefer to shop in stores or online? Why?

students.name: Eva
students.text: I like stores. I can see and touch the clothes.

students.name: Lily
students.text: I like online shopping. It is fast and easy.

professor.name: Dr. Stone
professor.text: What is the best place for a holiday: the beach or the mountains? Why?

students.name: Max
students.text: The beach. I love the sun and the sea.

students.name: Julia
students.text: The mountains. I like walking and fresh air.

professor.name: Mr. Young
professor.text: Do you like to work alone or with other people? Why?

students.name: Tim
students.text: I like to work alone. It is quiet and I can think.

students.name: Sofia
students.text: I like to work with people. We help each other.

professor.name: Ms. Park
professor.text: Should students wear a uniform at school? Why or why not?

students.name: Adam
students.text: Yes. It is easy in the morning. I don't choose my clothes.

students.name: Clara
students.text: No. I want to wear my own clothes. They are more comfortable.

professor.name: Dr. Lopez
professor.text: Do you like to get up early or late? Why?

students.name: Hugo
students.text: I get up early. I like the quiet morning.

students.name: Grace
students.text: I get up late. I love to sleep!

professor.name: Mr. Reed
professor.text: Is it better to have one good friend or many friends? Why?

students.name: Lena
students.text: One good friend is better. I can tell her everything.

students.name: Ryan
students.text: Many friends are better. I am never alone.

professor.name: Ms. Bell
professor.text: Do you like to eat fruit or sweets? Why?

students.name: Ivan
students.text: I like fruit. It is healthy and fresh.

students.name: Zoe
students.text: I like sweets. Chocolate makes me happy.

professor.name: Dr. Ward
professor.text: Do you prefer to listen to music or play music? Why?

students.name: Noah
students.text: I like to listen to music. I don't play an instrument.

students.name: Ella
students.text: I like to play the piano. It is fun to make music.

professor.name: Mr. Cook
professor.text: Is it better to walk or take the bus to school? Why?

students.name: Luca
students.text: Walking is better. It is good exercise.

students.name: Hana
students.text: The bus is better. It is fast and I am not tired.

professor.name: Ms. Moore
professor.text: Do you like big parties or small parties? Why?

students.name: Felix
students.text: Big parties. There is music and dancing.

students.name: Ana
students.text: Small parties. I can talk to everyone.

professor.name: Dr. Shaw
professor.text: Should people have a pet in an apartment? Why or why not?

students.name: Oscar
students.text: Yes. A small pet like a fish or a cat is fine.

students.name: Maya
students.text: No. Animals need a garden to play.

professor.name: Mr. Price
professor.text: Do you like to write by hand or on a computer? Why?

students.name: Eric
students.text: On a computer. It is fast and I can change words.

students.name: Lara
students.text: By hand. I remember things better.

professor.name: Ms. Ross
professor.text: What is better for a birthday: a party or a trip? Why?

students.name: Jon
students.text: A party. I can see all my friends.

students.name: Mila
students.text: A trip. I can see a new place.

professor.name: Dr. Hayes
professor.text: Do you like rainy days? Why or why not?

students.name: Kim
students.text: Yes. I stay at home and read a book.

students.name: Pedro
students.text: No. I cannot play outside.

professor.name: Mr. Bond
professor.text: Is it good to have a job when you are a student? Why or why not?

students.name: Tara
students.text: Yes. You can earn money and learn new things.

students.name: Igor
students.text: No. Students need time to study.

professor.name: Ms. Nash
professor.text: Do you like to learn new languages? Why or why not?

students.name: Mei
students.text: Yes. I can talk to people from other countries.

students.name: Tom
students.text: It is difficult for me, but it is useful for work.

professor.name: Dr. Kent
professor.text: Do you prefer tea or coffee? Why?

students.name: Rita
students.text: Tea. It is light and I drink it with my family.

students.name: Alex
students.text: Coffee. It helps me wake up in the morning.

professor.name: Mr. Ross
professor.text: Should children help at home? Why or why not?

students.name: Sana
students.text: Yes. They can clean their room and help their parents.

students.name: Ben
students.text: Yes, but only a little. Children need time to play.

professor.name: Ms. Lane
professor.text: Do you like to go to the cinema or watch films at home? Why?

students.name: Kai
students.text: The cinema. The screen is big and the sound is great.

students.name: Lisa
students.text: At home. It is cheap and I can stop the film.

professor.name: Dr. Fry
professor.text: What is the best way to learn new words? Why?

students.name: Pablo
students.text: I write words in a notebook every day.

students.name: Nora
students.text: I watch films in English and learn new words.

professor.name: Mr. Wells
professor.text: Do you like to go shopping with friends or alone? Why?

students.name: Dina
students.text: With friends. They tell me what looks good.

students.name: Sean
students.text: Alone. I am fast and I buy what I need.

professor.name: Ms. Owen
professor.text: Is breakfast important? Why or why not?

students.name: Jake
students.text: Yes. I am hungry in the morning and I need energy.

students.name: Elif
students.text: Not for me. I just drink coffee.

professor.name: Dr. Lane
professor.text: Do you like to visit museums? Why or why not?

students.name: Sophie
students.text: Yes. I like old things and art.

students.name: Marco
students.text: No. Museums are boring for me. I like parks.

professor.name: Mr. Hunt
professor.text: Is it better to study with music or in silence? Why?

students.name: Lea
students.text: With music. It helps me relax.

students.name: Karim
students.text: In silence. Music stops me thinking.

professor.name: Ms. Ray
professor.text: Do you prefer big cities or small towns for a holiday? Why?

students.name: Vera
students.text: Big cities. There is a lot to see.

students.name: Toby
students.text: Small towns. They are calm and friendly.

professor.name: Dr. Ball
professor.text: Should students have homework every day? Why or why not?

students.name: Rami
students.text: Yes. Homework helps us remember the lesson.

students.name: Ines
students.text: No. We need free time after school.

professor.name: Mr. Day
professor.text: Do you like to take photos? Why or why not?

students.name: Olga
students.text: Yes. I take photos of my friends and my food.

students.name: Luis
students.text: No. I like to look at things with my eyes.

professor.name: Ms. Kerr
professor.text: Do you like to ride a bicycle? Why or why not?

students.name: Finn
students.text: Yes. It is fast and good for the body.

students.name: Aya
students.text: No. The roads in my city are dangerous.

professor.name: Dr. Page
professor.text: What is better: a small car or a big car? Why?

students.name: Hans
students.text: A small car. It is easy to park.

students.name: Maria
students.text: A big car. My family is big!

professor.name: Mr. Cole
professor.text: Do you like to eat with your family every day? Why?

students.name: Ayumi
students.text: Yes. We talk about our day at dinner.

students.name: Tom
students.text: Sometimes. My parents work late.

professor.name: Ms. Lowe
professor.text: Is it fun to go camping? Why or why not?

students.name: Jana
students.text: Yes. I love sleeping under the stars.

students.name: Ravi
students.text: No. I don't like insects and cold nights.

professor.name: Dr. Snow
professor.text: Do you like to play video games? Why or why not?

students.name: Bruno
students.text: Yes. I play with my friends online.

students.name: Fatima
students.text: No. I prefer games with cards or a ball.

professor.name: Mr. Ash
professor.text: Is it better to live with your family or alone? Why?

students.name: Diego
students.text: With my family. I am not lonely.

students.name: Saskia
students.text: Alone. I can do what I want.

professor.name: Ms. Dale
professor.text: Do you like to wear new clothes or old clothes? Why?

students.name: Nadia
students.text: New clothes. I like to look nice.

students.name: Peter
students.text: Old clothes. They are very comfortable.

professor.name: Dr. Hart
professor.text: Should people drink more water? Why?

students.name: Gina
students.text: Yes. Water is good for your body and skin.

students.name: Yusuf
students.text: Yes. When I drink water, I am not tired.

professor.name: Mr. Moss
professor.text: Do you like to visit your grandparents? Why?

students.name: Emily
students.text: Yes. My grandmother cooks very good food.

students.name: Arjun
students.text: Yes. My grandfather tells funny stories.

professor.name: Ms. Vane
professor.text: Do you like to have a lot of things in your room or only a few? Why?

students.name: Lars
students.text: Only a few things. My room is clean and calm.

students.name: Chloe
students.text: A lot of things. I love my books and pictures.

professor.name: Dr. Rowe
professor.text: Is it good to play outside every day? Why?

students.name: Kofi
students.text: Yes. Fresh air is good for us.

students.name: Iris
students.text: Yes, but not when it is very cold.

professor.name: Mr. Tate
professor.text: What is your favorite food? Should we eat it every day?

students.name: Lina
students.text: My favorite food is pizza, but I don't eat it every day. It is not healthy.

students.name: Josh
students.text: I love rice. I eat it every day with vegetables.
